ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover potential connections to other entities
questions: What are the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I will use data analysis and public records to follow the money and investigate potential connections to other entities
